tokens.name: marquee
tokens.usage: The field. About 60% of a typical screen. Ink text (12.4:1) and the Tomato full stop sit on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Type, outlines, the dark button and dark sections. 12.4:1 on marquee, 18.8:1 on paper, 16.9:1 on butter, 17.9:1 on cream.

tokens.name: ink-70
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata. 7.7:1 on paper, 7.0:1 on butter, 7.4:1 on cream, 5.1:1 on marquee.

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: The full stop and the main button only. Never body text. Ink on tomato 5.1:1; white on tomato 3.7:1, so white only at 19px bold or larger. Tomato on marquee is 2.4:1: decorative full stop only.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, tickets and scene frames, with ink text.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Quiet studio surfaces, pills and tags, with ink text.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Soft page sections between marquee and paper, with ink text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers on paper, butter and cream. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Illustration only. Never text, buttons or backgrounds behind copy.

tokens.name: bubblegum
tokens.usage: Illustration only. Never text, buttons or backgrounds behind copy.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Illustration only. Never text, buttons or backgrounds behind copy.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted frame behind an illustration in a scene frame or tile.

tokens.name: bubblegum-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted frame behind an illustration in a scene frame or tile.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted frame behind an illustration in a scene frame or tile.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 3px solid outline with a 3px offset. 3.0:1 on marquee, 4.2:1 on ink, 4.5:1 on paper, 4.0:1 on butter.

styles.name: display-120
styles.sample: Not a card. A whole little world.
styles.usage: Hero headlines. Sentence case, ends on a full stop, the stop in tomato.

styles.name: display-56
